findings.description: No core-owned collection port: the CLI cannot legally reach collect_batch. arch-check forbids unisphere-cli -> unisphere-sdk, the guide declares collect_batch only as an SDK free function, and CollectionBatch is never assigned a home crate. Fix: add CollectionApi + CollectionBatch to core in tk-0001's frozen baseline, mirroring InspectionApi, and add a testkit FakeCollector.

findings.description: A physical record larger than max_record_bytes has no defined behaviour. LoadedBatch has no diagnostics channel, so the loader must either skip silently (violating ac-0003) or error permanently, making the rest of the session unreachable. Fix: typed Limit error at the record start offset, cursor not advanced, retry at the same cursor with a larger limit must succeed; add the case to vd-0002 and have the CLI name the remedy.
findings.evidence: guide contracts C1 (default 1048576), C3, C5; plan ac-0003

findings.description: SourceIdentity::Unavailable plus 'unsupported resume identity is a typed error' makes every multi-batch session unexportable on non-Unix, while the plan never scopes the slice to Unix and ac-0009/ac-000c claim installed-CLI export proof. Fix: either declare the loader Unix-only and fail fast with Unsupported, or permit Unavailable->Unavailable resume on path plus boundary offset as a documented weaker guarantee; prove the choice in vd-0002.
findings.evidence: guide contracts C1, C3, C12; plan non-goals; plan ac-0009, ac-000c

findings.description: vd-0006's source-surface purity check is specified in four words and the existing arch-check is a cargo metadata graph checker with no source inspection. A dependency graph cannot see std::fs/std::env/SystemTime::now, so the user's headline requirement would be proven by an unfalsifiable scan. Fix: enumerate the denied tokens in the guide, require a negative fixture under crates/testkit/fixtures/architecture/ that must fail, and document the known false-negative bound.

unisphere.source.kind is required on every record but its value domain is never given, and unisphere.usage.* component names are never listed. tk-0001 freezes the conformance helper asserting source-provenance in wave 0 while tk-0003 emits the keys in wave 1, so a mismatch surfaces only at integration; one namespace also has two documentation owners. Fix: closed attribute list in C6/C8 with key, type, emitting lane and optionality; docs/telemetry-profile.md as the single normative registry.
findings.evidence: guide contracts C6, C7, C8, C13; units tk-0001, tk-0003, tk-0004

findings.description: The OTLP proto revision is unpinned while the writer emits LogRecord eventName and omits resource, severityNumber/severityText and observedTimeUnixNano; records without a native timestamp emit no timeUnixNano. Fix: pin the opentelemetry-proto version in C9 and docs/telemetry-profile.md, document the intentionally absent fields and consumer expectations, and assert the exact top-level key set in one vd-0004 case.

PipelineErrorKind::Limit with a fixed per-kind message serves record-too-large, batch-budget-exhausted and listing-oversize; for listing the offset is meaningless, so the caller cannot tell which limit to raise. PipelineError is frozen at baseline. Fix: a closed reason discriminator yielding UNI-LIMIT-RECORD / UNI-LIMIT-BATCH / UNI-LIMIT-LISTING with distinct fixed fix strings.
findings.evidence: guide contracts C1, C2, C5; plan ac-0007

findings.description: ReadLimits states its invariant but not its enforcement point (public fields vs checked constructor), and SourceScope.max_sessions == 0 is undefined, so tk-0002 and tk-0005 will validate independently and disagree on the error kind. Fix: specify ReadLimits::new -> Result with private fields and accessors, or public fields plus a loader UNI-INPUT rejection, and define max_sessions == 0. Baseline decision.

unisphere.source.path is specified as a UTF-8 path while SessionRef.path is a PathBuf, and no owner is named for the mismatch; if the pure adapter rejects it, one badly-named file fails an entire export from inside the mapper. Fix: one sentence in C2 making the loader reject non-UTF-8 session paths with UNI-INPUT.

C9's 'bounded batch buffer' is bounded by nothing: write_batch takes no limit and AnyValue wrapping plus JSON escaping expands the input several-fold, so the wording implies a guarantee the signature cannot give while ac-000c claims bounded batches. Fix: reword to proportional-and-transitively-bounded, or give the writer an explicit maximum.

Non-recursive listing is sound for a first slice, but pointing --root at the natural Claude projects parent yields an empty list and exit 0, indistinguishable from 'nothing found'. Fix: an explicit recursive:false field in the already-versioned list response plus a leaf-directory note in --help and docs/session-loader.md.

ac-0001's proof list names only vd-0003 and vd-0005, both test runs, which cannot prove the adapter has no filesystem dependency; the check that does is vd-0006, as bp-0001 itself states. Fix: add vd-0006 to ac-0001's proof list.

If [workspace.dependencies] gains path entries for the three new crates at baseline, those directories do not exist until wave 1; members = crates/* also admits each new crate to the workspace before the arch-check allow-list is updated. Unverified by this reviewer because confirming it needs a cargo run. Fix: declare only external deps (time, libc) at baseline and add internal path entries with the allow-list update in wave 2.
